shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, low relief
incised hatched/striated detailing on animal bodies
animal with clearly rendered legs and paws in horizontal procession
justification: Both show simplified quadrupeds in profile with splayed legs carved in shallow relief on coarse, weathered limestone, with incised hatching used to texture the bodies, and in each case the animals read as moving along a horizontal line. The decisive difference is composition and depth: A pairs a single bold high-relief, almost three-dimensional beast projecting over a stone edge with one flat profile animal, whereas B is a flat slab organised into stacked registers with a row of three repeated arch-shaped objects above a band of animals and further figures below.
